decision_policy.identifier_level_evidence: Accept an official Crossref relationship only when relation-type, id-type, identifier, and asserted-by are all present in the retrieved record and the identifier resolves to the exact arXiv record under review.
decision_policy.metadata_level_evidence: When no identifier relationship is reported, require agreement of the official title and complete ordered author list, an explicit publication statement in the repository record, and a corresponding official publisher record.
decision_policy.title_search: Search results may retrieve a candidate but do not establish identity.
decision_policy.identifier_type: Do not infer an identifier type from the identifier string.
